rules: The artwork must be completed within 90 minutes.

rounds.title: Matches
rules: Eight registered players per team: six on the pitch and two substitutes.
All eight players must be present before their slot; late players cannot join later.
Each match has two 10-minute halves and a 5-minute break, with no extra time.
All players must carry valid ID; player swapping is not allowed.
There is no offside rule. Kick-offs are from halfway; kick-ins and corners are allowed.
Unlimited rolling substitutions are allowed after the exiting player leaves the playing area.
Penalty kicks are no-step penalties.
Slide tackles are prohibited; sliding to control the ball is allowed only when no opponent is nearby.
Two yellow cards or a direct red card dismisses a player from the match.
Goalkeepers cannot pick up a deliberate pass from a teammate.
Drawn matches are decided by a three-penalty shoot-out followed by sudden death.
Sudden-death takers must differ from the first three takers; red-carded players cannot take penalties.
Shin pads are advised; organizers are not responsible for injury.
Direct free kicks are allowed.
A drop ball restarts play after a temporary stoppage.

rounds.title: Matches
rules: Seven registered players per team: six players and one substitute.
Each innings is 6 overs; each bowler may bowl at most 1 over.
No byes, leg byes or LBW.
All seven players must be present before their slot; late players cannot join later.
All players must carry valid ID; player swapping is not allowed.
Only full-arm bowling is allowed.
The run-up is limited to 2 steps.
Intensive sledging is prohibited.
Touching the top net scores 4; a net-touch catch is not out.
Runs and overthrows are allowed while the ball remains in the playing area.
A wide awards 1 run.
A grounded hit through the batsman’s opposite side scores 4.
A direct net hit on the batsman’s opposite side scores 6.
A no-ball gives a free hit.

rounds.title: Elimination Rounds
rules: Bring your own rackets and shuttlecocks.
Non-marking shoes are compulsory.
No hooting or shouting is allowed.
Participants must wear proper sports attire; pajamas and shorts are allowed.
The first round is played to 11 points and all other rounds are played to 15 points.
Only 1 minute is allowed for knocking before the match.
All rounds are elimination rounds.

rounds.title: Knockout / Elimination Rounds
rules: Organizers provide tables, rackets and balls.
Wear comfortable sports attire and suitable footwear.
Report 15 minutes before the allotted match time.
All matches use a knockout/elimination format.
Each match is best of 3 games; each game is played to 11 points.
A game must be won by 2 points; at 10-10 play continues until a two-point lead.
There is no second serve; a service fault awards the opponent a point.
Volleying is not allowed; the ball must bounce once on the player’s side.
First server is decided by toss.
Service alternates every 2 points and every point at 10-10.
Players change ends after every game and at 5 points in the deciding game.
Touching the table with the non-racket hand or racket during play awards the opponent a point.
Hooting, abuse, deliberate distraction or unsportsmanlike conduct may cause warning, penalty or disqualification.
The referee or organizing committee decides injury or postponement matters.
Referee and organizing committee decisions are final and binding.
